label: Every actual root withholds each grounded being, from uniform giving at the root (inference)
rule: The root is two-way toward a contingent being, so by uniformity toward every being it gives
meaning: Every actual root is the common root n of 0c27f65a (only its root and reach clauses are used). A concrete being c contingent at w (c76b6e2c) is absent at some accessible v, where the necessary n exists; so c is not n, n grounds c, n gives c being at w by (b) and not at v by factive giving: n is two-way toward c. By uniformity n is two-way toward every being it gives at w, and by (b) it gives each actual concretum it grounds. Constructive.
